crossRefs.note: Salvation is far from the wicked, for they don’t seek your statutes.
They tell God, ‘Depart from us, for we don’t want to know about your ways.
What is the Almighty, that we should serve him? What profit should we have, if we pray to him?’

You hypocrites! Well did Isaiah prophesy of you, saying,
‘These people draw near to me with their mouth, and honor me with their lips; but their heart is far from me.
But now in Christ Jesus you who once were far off are made near in the blood of Christ.
He came and preached peace to you who were far off and to those who were near.

translations.web: For, behold, those who are far from you shall perish. You have destroyed all those who are unfaithful to you.
translations.bsb: Those far from You will surely perish; You destroy all who are unfaithful to You.
translations.kjv: For, lo, they that are far from thee shall perish: thou hast destroyed all them that go a whoring
translations.asv: For, lo, they that are far from thee shall perish: Thou hast destroyed all them that play the harlot, departing from thee.
